steps: refuse entire export if canonical redaction would change any selected event
build ATDP with no generation timestamp
security reviewer opens the export request against the ordered event range
reviewer independently recomputes canonical redaction over every selected event
reviewer diffs recomputed redaction against the export-time redaction, byte for byte
any diff refuses the export and files a security exception, superseding the default path
a clean diff co-signs the package before it leaves the security-reviewed lane
flows.failure: a redaction diff refuses the export and is never silently reconciled
flows.determinism: byte-identical given the same event range and the same reviewer ruleset
